text: Since yesterday, electronics moved most on Amazon (about +1,240 reviews), led by a ₹339 DIZORO iPhone 15 silicone case (+274), with beauty (+808, led by a ₹399 Ghar Soaps bath bar pack at +102) and health & fitness (+520) next. For a beginner, phone cases, crossbody and sling bags, simple toys and kitchen consumables like butter paper and air fryer liners look most reachable, because big brands lead almost everything else.

headline: Women's ethnic: kurta sets lead, Banarasi-style sarees rise
text: Kurta sets from GoSriKi and Klosia have the most reviews (a ₹652 GoSriKi Anarkali set with about 11,800). The category added about 230 reviews since yesterday, led by a ₹699 Klosia straight kurta set (+24), a ₹699 GoSriKi set (+17) and a ₹799 Klosia Anarkali set (+16). Yashika and C J Enterprise Banarasi and Kanjivaram-style sarees around ₹330 to ₹550 are rising, which likely fits the wedding season through December. The typical price is about ₹749, and the top 10 products have about 11.2% 1-star reviews, the highest on Amazon, so sizes and complaints make this hard for a beginner.

headline: Women's western: slow, Korean-style tops and party maxi dresses
text: Amazon's own Symbol T-shirts have the most reviews (about 26,000), followed by Leriya Fashion dresses. Growth was small, about 120 reviews since yesterday, with a ₹599 Shasmi New Year party maxi dress and a ₹399 KZULLY maxi dress (+9 each) and a ₹499 LITZO Korean-style shirt (+7) gaining most. RIEKA embroidered tops around ₹645 to ₹695 keep rising, and ribbed tops and a maxi dress are new to the list. The typical price is about ₹499, and the top 10 have about 9% 1-star reviews, so sizes and fit are a real risk.

headline: Men's clothing: Allen Solly and Van Heusen rule
text: Big brands lead: Allen Solly and Van Heusen polo T-shirts and Amazon's Symbol polo have the most reviews. The category added about 250 reviews since yesterday, led by the ₹399 Symbol polo (+20), the ₹791 Allen Solly polo (+17) and a ₹371 Lux Cozi T-shirt (+13). Deemoon and Deelmo casual shirts at ₹495 and Boldfit and Lymio winter jackets are rising, and new listings include a Ben Martin jacket and a Max lounge T-shirt. The typical price is about ₹579 with about 9% 1-star reviews among the top 10; brands plus sizes make this hard for a beginner.

headline: Kids & toys: cheap card games lead, scooters and learning toys move
text: Mattel's UNO card games (₹99 and ₹169) and a ₹157 Babique rattle ball have the most reviews. The category added about 190 reviews since yesterday, led by a ₹899 Lifelong kick scooter (+30), a ₹1,599 Kidsmate tricycle (+15) and a ₹752 Wembley kids' learning laptop (+15). New listings and rising newcomers are mostly girls' co-ord and winter sets from Trampoline, Goodwish and Cubbyhug. The typical price is about ₹540 with about 8.6% 1-star reviews among the top 10. Unbranded toys have no sizes and suit a beginner, with Christmas gifting about six weeks away.

headline: Home & kitchen: Pigeon and Milton lead, cheap lights and lighters move
text: Brands lead: a ₹189 Pigeon chopper (about 250,800 reviews) and Milton bottles are at the top, with Ajanta clocks close behind. The category's net count fell by about 350 reviews, but only because one TEX-RO dish rack dropped from 3,881 to 3,019 reviews (likely Amazon regrouped its listing); the other products gained about 510. The fastest movers were a ₹69 Ganesh gas lighter (+38), a ₹259 Aliston kitchen scale (+36) and a ₹99 DesiDiya LED string light (+30), and ₹149 butter paper and ₹289 air fryer liners are still rising. The typical price is about ₹249 with about 7.5% 1-star reviews among the top 10; small unbranded items like lights and kitchen papers are the beginner way in.

headline: Beauty: strong growth, all big brands
text: Dettol handwash, Vaseline lotion, Cetaphil face wash and Parachute lotion lead, all big brands. Beauty added about 810 reviews since yesterday, the second most on Amazon, led by a ₹399 Ghar Soaps bath bar pack (+102), Cetaphil face wash (+46) and a ₹222 Derma Co anti-acne face wash (+40). A Be Bodywise underarm roll-on and a L'Oreal conditioner are rising, and winter moisturisers fit the season. The typical price is about ₹299 with only about 5.3% 1-star reviews among the top 10, but a beginner cannot easily compete with these brands.

headline: Jewellery: almost no movement on Amazon
text: YouBella bracelets, earrings and jewellery sets have the most reviews, followed by Shining Diva. The category barely moved, only about 19 reviews since yesterday, with a ₹297 Shining Diva crystal bracelet gaining most (+3). Only 31 products were read here and there are no new listings, while a ₹798 Shining Diva 12-pair earring set and a ₹265 Rajasthani lac bangle set are rising. The typical price is about ₹285 with about 9.6% 1-star reviews among the top 10. Jewellery is light and needs no sizes, but Amazon demand looks much weaker than on Meesho.

headline: Bags & footwear: orthopedic slippers lead, crossbody bags rise
text: Doctor Extra Soft orthopedic slippers and flip-flops have the most reviews, with Lavie handbags and Asian sneakers next. The category added about 170 reviews since yesterday, led by ₹999 Frido slippers (+11), a ₹1,711 ZOUK jute tote (+9) and a ₹339 Wooum sling bag (+8). Rising newcomers are a ₹579 Walizza sling bag, ₹479 Lyrovo crescent crossbody bags and clutches, and a ₹649 Lavie wallet. The typical price is about ₹570 with about 8.3% 1-star reviews among the top 10; bags have no sizes and suit a beginner better than footwear.

headline: Electronics: biggest jump of the day, led by a phone case
text: Brand earphones lead: a OnePlus neckband, JBL and boAt wired earphones and realme buds. The category added about 1,240 reviews since yesterday, the most on Amazon, led by a ₹339 DIZORO iPhone 15 silicone case (+274), OnePlus Nord Buds (+57) and the OnePlus neckband (+53). Samsung chargers and cables, a ₹199 Portronics braided cable and a ₹312 Samsung A17 silicone case are rising. The typical price is about ₹599 with about 9.6% 1-star reviews among the top 10; unbranded phone cases for popular models are the realistic beginner option, not earphones.

headline: Health & fitness: trimmers lead growth, home gym gear rises
text: Dettol handwash, a Havells hair dryer and a Philips straightener lead. The category added about 520 reviews since yesterday, led by a ₹1,699 Philips trimmer (+53), a ₹240 WishCare lip balm (+24) and a ₹699 Havells trimmer (+22), with ₹549 Lifelong dumbbells and a ₹164 Boldfit hand gripper (+21 each) close behind. A ₹549 Slovic pull-up bar is #1 in its list, and Vaseline lip tins are rising. The typical price is about ₹366 with the lowest complaint rate on Amazon, about 4.5% 1-star among the top 10; simple fitness gear like grippers and pull-up bars is the beginner-friendly part.

Silicone phone cases for popular models around ₹300 to ₹350
Crossbody, sling and crescent bags around ₹340 to ₹600
Simple toys and card games around ₹100 to ₹400 (Christmas gifting)
LED string and curtain lights around ₹100 to ₹400 (Christmas and New Year)
Butter paper, air fryer liners and gas lighters around ₹70 to ₹300
Hand grippers, pull-up bars and small fitness gear around ₹160 to ₹600

Avoid for now: earphones and neckbands (OnePlus, JBL and boAt dominate), branded beauty and personal care (Dettol, Cetaphil, Vaseline), branded men's polos, and size-heavy ethnic wear with over 11% 1-star reviews among the top 10.
